platforms.name: tiktok
platforms.overallStrategy: Focus on completion rate optimization and trending audio usage. TikTok's batch testing model rewards content that retains viewers above platform-average completion rates.

platforms.name: reddit
platforms.overallStrategy: Prioritize early engagement velocity with value-driven content. Reddit's Hot algorithm heavily weights the first 1-2 hours of engagement, making timing and subreddit selection critical.

algorithmPriorities.description: TikTok's #1 ranking signal. Videos watched to completion get exponentially more distribution through the batch testing model.
algorithmPriorities.recentChanges: As of Q1 2026, longer videos (2-3 min) are now viable as TikTok has adjusted completion rate expectations by video length.

algorithmPriorities.description: Shares to friends, other platforms, or DMs indicate content worth spreading. Shares have become increasingly important as TikTok expands its social features.
algorithmPriorities.recentChanges: TikTok now tracks share context (DM vs. external) and rewards in-app shares more.

algorithmPriorities.description: Reddit's Hot algorithm uses logarithmic time decay — the first 10 upvotes matter more than the next 100. Content must gain engagement in the first 1-2 hours or it dies.
Posts with deep comment threads (replies to replies) signal genuine community engagement and get boosted in Hot and Best sorts.

rankingSignals.description: Percentage of viewers who watch the video to the end. The single most important metric for FYP distribution.
How many viewers watch the video more than once. Indicates highly engaging or informative content.
Content watermarked from other platforms (Instagram Reels logo) gets suppressed distribution.
Speed of upvote accumulation in the first 1-2 hours after posting. Logarithmic time decay means early votes count exponentially more.
Posts with high comment engagement relative to views signal quality discussion content.

optimizationStrategies.strategy: Front-load the hook in first 0.5-1 second
optimizationStrategies.description: Create an immediate visual or audio impact within the first half-second to maximize retention and prevent scroll-past.
optimizationStrategies.implementation: Open with a bold text overlay, surprising visual, or compelling audio hook. Avoid intros, logos, or slow builds.

optimizationStrategies.strategy: Use trending audio within first 48 hours of trend
optimizationStrategies.description: Leverage trending sounds early in their lifecycle for maximum algorithmic boost before saturation.
optimizationStrategies.implementation: Monitor TikTok Creative Center daily for emerging sounds. Create content using trending audio within 24-48 hours of the sound beginning to trend.

optimizationStrategies.strategy: Post during US morning hours (6-9 AM ET) on weekdays
optimizationStrategies.description: Maximize the engagement runway by posting when US audiences are waking up, giving the post maximum hours to accumulate upvotes.
optimizationStrategies.implementation: Schedule or manually post at 6-8 AM ET on Tuesday-Thursday. Avoid late Friday, Saturday, and holiday posting.

optimizationStrategies.strategy: Use data-driven or original analysis titles
optimizationStrategies.description: Reddit audiences reward original thinking and data. Posts framed as original analysis consistently outperform opinion-only posts.
optimizationStrategies.implementation: Include specific numbers, data points, or 'I analyzed X' framing in post titles. Back claims with sources in the post body.

recommendations: For TikTok: Prioritize completion rate by keeping videos short (15-30s) and front-loading hooks. Use trending audio within 48 hours of trend emergence. Avoid content that doesn't deliver on its hook promise. For Reddit: Post original analysis content at 6-8 AM ET on Tuesday-Thursday. Focus on sparking discussion through contrarian or data-driven angles. Build community credibility through consistent valuable comments before posting original content.
